_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0/36 directional base rate makes HOLD the statistically dominant call, and with Fed_liquidity pinned at 0 there is no visible coil-breaker to justify a directional bet — Disbelief is the adjacent lean if sidelined capital begins deploying.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on HOLD direction, but analyst forward-calls Disbelief while narrative implies a violent bullish resolution without naming a specific next phase.
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity rises above 20 with btc_momentum_30d sustaining above 55 and funding cooling below 45
next_move.invalidated_if: mvrv_zscore drops below 15 with fear_greed below 20 and vix spiking above 80 — would signal true bottom-2024-aug replication, forcing phase shift to Panic/Capitulation
